description: Models what a multi-year program of private-fund commitments (PE, VC, private credit and similar) does to cash flow over its life: capital calls, distributions, unrealized value and the year with the worst net cash flow. Uses a simplified adaptation of the Takahashi-Alexander pacing framework and runs several named forward-looking growth scenarios. Pass annual_liquidity_budget to see which years a stated budget would be breached. Without an active plugin subscription, returns the peak liquidity need under one scenario; with one, adds the multi-scenario comparison and year-by-year detail.

annual_commitment.description: Dollar amount you'd commit to new private-fund vintages each year

annual_liquidity_budget.description: Optional — your actual annual liquidity budget for capital calls, to flag years it would be breached

fund_life_years.description: Assumed life of each fund vintage in years (default 12)

investment_period_years.description: Years each vintage actively calls capital before calls stop (default 5)

rate_of_contribution.description: Fraction of a vintage's uncalled capital called per year during its investment period (default 0.30)

rate_of_distribution.description: Base annual distribution rate applied to unrealized value, back-loaded via a bow curve (default 0.20)

scenario.description: A single scenario id (historical_baseline, regime_transition, ai_productivity_acceleration, structural_stagnation) to run one scenario only — omit to see the full range (subscription required)

vintage_years.description: How many consecutive years you keep making new commitments (default 5)

name: alts.illiquidity_pacing_stress_test
title: Illiquidity Stress-Test / Commitment-Pacing Model
